title: PostgreSQL rejects an unknown role
root_cause: The import invokes psql as oriole_reader, but the PostgreSQL service has not created that role. The server is reachable and rejects the login, so the command and job fail.

relevant_evidence.why: The database reports the nonexistent role and the command exits.
The import invokes psql using that role.
The service publishes PostgreSQL without creating the requested role.
